description: This file defines service functions for managing variables, including create, delete, retrieve, update, and import operations, with external dependencies on database repositories, error handling, and platform-specific logic.

methods.name: createVariable
methods.description: Creates a new variable, checks platform constraints, saves to database, and sends telemetry.

methods.name: deleteVariable
methods.description: Deletes a variable by ID and workspace ID from the database.

methods.name: getAllVariables
methods.description: Retrieves all variables for a workspace, with optional pagination, excluding 'runtime' type in cloud platform.

methods.name: getVariableById
methods.description: Fetches a variable by ID and workspace ID, with platform-specific restrictions.

methods.name: updateVariable
methods.description: Updates an existing variable, with platform constraints.

methods.name: importVariables
methods.description: Imports multiple variables, handling duplicates, validation, and platform-specific filtering.
